ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols as shown on Map No. 2-1

in the area bounded by:

A line 53.16 feet south of and parallel to Lexington Street; the public alley next east and
parallel to California Avenue; a line 106.32 feet south of and parallel to Lexington
Street; and South California Avenue.

To those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 739-41 S. California Avenue
